LanguageData.NR_FixerSpecialtyDesc_Broker: Deals in information. Pays half as much again for data delivery contracts.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpecialtyDesc_Cleaner: Erases traces for a living. Scrubbing your Heat is cheaper with a cleaner.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpecialtyDesc_Fence: Moves hardware. Sells cyberware and hacking gear, delivered by drop pod.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitUnknownDesc: You don't know this fixer well enough yet. The trait is revealed at {0} reputation.
LanguageData.NR_FixerPinnedTag: Pinned: this fixer stays when the others rotate, and the trait is known.
LanguageData.NR_FixerReputationTip: Every deal raises reputation. Higher reputation means lower prices. At {0} the fixer stays with you for good.
LanguageData.NR_FixerCalled: {0} picked up. The channel cost {1} silver.
LanguageData.NR_NotEnoughSilver: Not enough silver in storage: {0} needed.
LanguageData.NR_FixerScrubbed: {0} scrubbed {1} points of your digital trace.
LanguageData.NR_FixerPinned: {0} trusts you now and will stay in your contacts.
LanguageData.NR_FixerRatLeak: {0} sold information about your colony. Your trace grew.
LanguageData.NR_FixersRotated: New fixers have appeared on the network.
LanguageData.NR_ScrubRates: Rate: {0} Heat per cyberdata, {1} per advanced cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_FixerCallTip: Pay the fixer to open a channel for {0} hours. While it is open you can scrub your trace, shop and accept contracts.
LanguageData.NR_FixerScrubTip: Hand over cyberdata from storage to lower your digital Heat.
LanguageData.NR_FixerShopTip: Buy hacking gear. Goods arrive by drop pod.
LanguageData.NR_ShopRestock: New stock arrives with the next fixer rotation, in {0}.
LanguageData.NR_ClubCallAlliesTip: Spend the favor: an allied faction sends fighters (or the group sends advanced data). Once a season.
LanguageData.NR_FixerFreeScrubTip: The fixer owes you: scrub {0} Heat for free, no call needed.
LanguageData.NR_FixerHeldTip: Stays through rotations until you let go.
LanguageData.NR_FixerHoldTip: Keep this fixer through the pool rotations for {1} silver per rotation: the first is paid now, the next when the pool changes (if you cannot pay, the hold lapses). Up to {0} unpinned fixers at once.
LanguageData.NR_FixerBreakTip: Drop this fixer: reputation is lost, offers are cancelled; walking out on a running contract makes them take cyberdata from your storage (or leak your trace); a new fixer takes the place. They won't be back for {0} days.
LanguageData.NR_FixerBreakConfirm: Break ties with {0}? Reputation and any contract with them are lost. They won't come back for {1} days.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTiesBroken: Ties with {0} broken. {1} joins the pool.
LanguageData.NR_FixerHoldLapsed: No silver to keep {0} ({1}): the hold lapsed.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpiteData: {0} took it badly that you walked out on the contract and pulled {1} cyberdata out of your storage on the way out.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpiteHeat: {0} took it badly that you walked out on the contract. With nothing to take, he leaked your trace: Heat +{1}.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpiteLog: {0} leaked the trace out of spite
LanguageData.NR_ScrubMaxTip: Just enough to bring the Heat to zero (or all you have).
LanguageData.NR_ShopBlackTip: Sold only while the black market is open, one of each.
LanguageData.NR_ClubRotateNowTip: Call in a new pool now instead of waiting. Pinned and held fixers and those with a running contract stay. Costs {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Greedy: + More goods in his shop. − Everything costs a quarter more, the call too.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Reliable: + Forgives a failed contract by half (shorter silence, smaller reputation loss) and never sends anyone after you. − Contract rewards are 10% lower.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Rat: + Cheap: everything and the call cost 20% less. − Sometimes sells the colony out after a deal (+10 Heat), more often after a failed contract.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Paranoid: + While he is in the pool, revenge raids against the colony come 25% weaker: he leaks their plans. − Does not pick up the phone while your Heat is Tracked or higher.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Gambler: + The pay is rolled when the job is done: from half to almost double, a bit more on average. − Nothing is guaranteed.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Loyal: + Reputation grows twice as fast; once pinned, an extra 10% discount. − Will not work for you while a pinned fixer of his trade is in the pool.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Veteran: + The scrub is 20% more effective. − The call costs 30% more.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Collector: + Always keeps his rare goods in the shop, even before you are pinned. − Fewer ordinary goods.
LanguageData.NR_FixerTraitDesc_Hothead: + Contracts pay 40% more. − They are 40% shorter, and a failure adds 10 Heat.
LanguageData.NR_FixerRefuseParanoid: {0} does not pick up: too hot for him while your Heat is {1} or higher.
LanguageData.NR_FixerRefuseLoyal: {0} does not work with you while {1} is your pinned fixer.
LanguageData.NR_FixerHotheadFail: {0} made noise over the failed job
LanguageData.NR_FixerParanoidWarning: {0}, the paranoid fixer, heard of it first and leaked their plans: they will come weaker.
LanguageData.NR_FixerSpecialtyDesc_Imperial: An agent of the Empire who needs deniable netrunners. Pays less silver, but each finished contract adds royal favor to your best-known colonist. Deals only with a colony at peace with the Empire.
LanguageData.NR_FixerRefuseImperial: {0} does not deal with enemies of the Empire.
LanguageData.NR_ImperialFavor: {0} put in a word at court: {1} gains {2} royal favor.
LanguageData.NR_FixerHoldPaidMsg: {0} stays in the pool through the next rotation. Paid {1} silver.
